home.bannerTitle: More to enjoy, less to pay
home.bannerLead: Discover local deals on cleaning, beauty and chauffeur services.
home.title: Local experiences at a fair price
home.lead: Clear prices including VAT, real local businesses and a {days}-day refund on unused vouchers.
home.emptyTitle: The first deals are on their way
home.emptyText: Local businesses are joining Vendelia right now. Run a business? Be among the first to list your offer.
home.step1Text: Every deal shows the final price including VAT, what's included and the terms.
home.step2Text: Pay by online banking, MobilePay or card. You see every charge before you pay.
home.step3Text: Your voucher and its exact expiry date arrive by email and in My vouchers.
home.step4Text: Book with the business as the deal describes and show your code on site.
home.refundText: Changed your plans? Cancel an unused voucher in My vouchers within {days} days of purchase. Vouchers are valid for {months} calendar months.
home.bizText: Reach new customers in the Helsinki region. You set the offer – we handle payments, vouchers and support.
home.bizPoint1: {rate} commission on the VAT-exclusive sale. No sign-up or monthly fees.
home.bizPoint2: Every statement line is visible: sale, VAT, commission and payout.

deal.validityTerm: The voucher is valid for {months} calendar months from the purchase date
deal.buyTodayValid: If you buy today, the voucher is valid until {date}. The exact date is printed on the voucher.
deal.refundBody: You can cancel an unused voucher for a full refund within {days} days of purchase in My vouchers or by emailing tuki@vendelia.fi. We send a confirmation and refund your original payment method. Used vouchers follow the business's terms and your statutory rights.
deal.onBehalf: Vendelia sells the voucher on behalf of the business. The business provides the service.

deal.giftTick: Can be bought as a gift – choose at checkout
deal.secureTick: Secure payment: online banking, MobilePay, card
